title: AISHELL-3 adapter: layout discovery, failure taxonomy and speaker-grouped manifest
hypothesis: Given a local AISHELL-3 tree, a manifest built only from content.txt + WAV headers records every accepted utterance with a stable SHA256 and turns every rejected file into a counted issue code; speaker-grouped dev carving keeps the official test split intact and provably leaks no speaker.
dataset_kind: synthetic-fixture (no real AISHELL-3 on this machine)
command: pytest tests/test_data_aishell3.py -q; pytest -q; python -m vhe manifest --root /tmp/vhe_exp0004/AISHELL-3 --output experiments/EXP-0004/logs/manifest_demo.jsonl --dev-fraction 0.5
gpu: Apple M5 (MPS available; not used by this experiment)
notes: Record created after the adapter code was written (process deviation, documented in README). No real audio used.
